title: Broken mounting flange (rendered)
story: A rendered part, no photo: a 56 mm flange snapped off on one side, taking two of its four bolt holes with it. It shows a complete mirror rebuild, lost holes included.
label: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE: a rendered part on a rendered Re-Forge mat, shot by a simulated phone camera (RE-FORGE tools/make_test_photos.py). Not a photo of a real part.

truth.photographed: 45.6 mm wide: two Ø6.5 holes were lost in the break

title: Broken chain sprocket (06A21)
story: A real 21-tooth chain sprocket (stamped 06A21, marking visible), snapped along a diameter: the top half with about ten teeth is gone. The bore survives, so the mirror stays pinned while it rebuilds the missing teeth.
label: SYNTHETIC COMPOSITE for the app examples: a user-provided photo of a real part placed on a rendered mat, shot by a simulated phone camera. Not a real photo.

truth.basis: CHOSEN 70.0 mm outside diameter: a 06A chain's 9.525 mm pitch gives a 21-tooth pitch diameter of 63.9 mm and an outside diameter of about 69.7 mm
truth.photographed: 64.6 mm tall: the top half snapped off along a diameter

title: Square engine-style gasket
story: A real square gasket with a round bore and eight passages, intact and placed at an angle. Nothing to rebuild: it's measured as photographed, ready to cut a copy from gasket sheet.
label: SYNTHETIC COMPOSITE: a real photo of a real square gasket with a round bore and eight passages (Gasket01.jpg by Miya.m, CC BY-SA 3.0, Wikimedia Commons), cut out and placed on a rendered Re-Forge mat at a stated size, shot by a simulated phone camera. Not a real photo of the mat.

truth.basis: 82.2 mm long side, from the same photo's scale, which is CHOSEN: the round flange gasket beside it on the same sheet at Ø100 mm (the outside diameter of a JIS B 2404 10K 20A full-face gasket); the photo has no ruler

title: Chain sprocket (06A21), intact
story: The same 21-tooth chain sprocket (06A21), intact: measured as photographed. The pipeline must rebuild nothing — proof it does not invent damage.
label: SYNTHETIC COMPOSITE for the app examples: a user-provided photo of a real part placed on a rendered mat, shot by a simulated phone camera. Not a real photo.

truth.basis: CHOSEN 70.0 mm outside diameter (same basis as the broken one)
truth.photographed: placed at 25° to the mat, whole
